body:
T-MANIFEST-FOREST's own spec (docs/specs/segmented-gate-manifest.md §12 AC10) requires: "doctor reports orphaned anchors and stale lineage tokens read-only", verified by `node --test packages/tickets/test/doctor.test.mjs --test-name-pattern='manifest'`. This is explicitly slice 8 in the ticket's own slice plan ("Docs + doctor check") and was deliberately not implemented in slice 3 (the segment writer, PR #411) or any slice shipped before it.

Currently packages/tickets/lib/doctor.mjs's doctorTicketStore only runs 'active-store', 'transactions', 'writer-lock', 'current-ticket', and 'storehash-manifest-bind' checks — no orphaned-anchor check and no stale-lineage-token check exist anywhere in the codebase (grepped packages/tickets and packages/gate-manifest for 'orphan': zero matches). docs/tools/gate-manifest.md also has zero mentions of manifest.d/, forest, or segment — the forest-mode documentation debt from AC10 is unmet too.

Acceptance criteria:
1. doctorTicketStore (packages/tickets/lib/doctor.mjs) gains a new read-only check that reports (a) a segment whose anchor points at a root seq or another segment's line that no longer exists (orphaned anchor), and (b) a .lineage token whose named segment no longer exists or whose cached ULID no longer matches the segment file (stale lineage token). Both are REPORTED, never auto-repaired — doctor stays read-only per this file's existing convention. Verify: node --test packages/tickets/test/doctor.test.mjs --test-name-pattern='manifest'
2. docs/tools/gate-manifest.md documents manifest.d/, the forest read/write model, and the new doctor check. Verify: grep -l 'manifest.d' docs/tools/gate-manifest.md
3. Existing doctor test suite stays green. Verify: node --test packages/tickets/test/doctor.test.mjs
title: T-MANIFEST-FOREST Slice 8: doctor check for orphaned anchors and stale lineage tokens, plus forest docs
